run_ProposalModule_forward: run the ProposalModule forward pass with xyz coordinates and features to generate object proposals
create_ProposalModule: create a ProposalModule instance with num_class, heading bins, size clusters, and sampling strategy
decode_scores_function: decode raw network output into objectness scores, center, heading, size, and semantic class scores
review_ProposalModule_sampling: review the ProposalModule sampling strategies including vote_fps, seed_fps, and random sampling modes
test_ProposalModule_endpoints: test the ProposalModule forward pass and verify end_points output shapes for aggregated votes and scores
